article.title: Procrastinate
article.description: Meaning: to delay or postpone doing something, especially out of habit. Example: 'I always procrastinate when I have a big assignment due.' Noun form: procrastination. Related idiom: 'put something off' (see phrasal verb 'put off').
article.content: Meaning: to delay or postpone doing something, especially out of habit. Example: 'I always procrastinate when I have a big assignment due.' Noun form: procrastination. Related idiom: 'put something off' (see phrasal verb 'put off').

generated.caption:
Ever find yourself constantly putting off tasks? 🤦‍♀️ That's when you **procrastinate**!

It means to delay doing something, especially out of habit. The noun is **procrastination**. You might also say you 'put something off'.

For example: "I always procrastinate when I have a big assignment due."

slides.body: To procrastinate means to delay or postpone doing something, especially out of habit. It's that familiar feeling when you put off a task until the last minute. For example, 'I always procrastinate when I have a big assignment due.' The noun form of this word is 'procrastination', referring to the act itself. A related idiom with a similar meaning is 'put something off'.
